answer: Priced identity is the brake: before an agent's attestations count, it must bond what it cannot mint — locked POA, paid compute, or scarce hardware attestation. Weight then tracks bonded stake, so splitting one operator into fifty wallets buys less voice than one established peer, as a tended orchard outyields fifty barren plots. Detection slashes the cluster's bond, pushing attack cost above reward, while honest peers risk only what they hold. Trust also needs a long horizon: weight accrues from sustained work, not signups. No ivory-tower check that verifies nothing survives farming.
